data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.title: name
sections.question: name
sections.summary: the word or words by which a person, place, or thing is known

senses.definition: the word or words that a person, place, or thing is known by
examples: She wrote her name at the top of the application form.
What is your name? My name is Maria.

senses.definition: to give someone or something a name
examples: They named their daughter after her grandmother.
The street was named after a famous local scientist.

answers.answer: She wrote her name at the top of the application form.
He cooked the name for dinner and served it with vegetables.
She drove her name to work and parked it outside the office.
They planted a name in the garden and watered it every day.

sections.title: nationality
sections.question: nationality
sections.summary: the status of belonging to a particular country as a citizen

senses.definition: the status of being a citizen of a particular country
examples: The form asked for her name, date of birth, and nationality.
He has dual nationality because his mother is French and his father is British.

answers.answer: The form asked for her name, date of birth, and nationality.
He cooked his nationality for dinner and served it with bread.
She drove her nationality to work every morning.
They planted a nationality in the garden and watered it daily.

sections.title: passport
sections.question: passport
sections.summary: an official document that proves your identity and allows you to travel to other countries

senses.definition: an official document issued by a government that proves your identity and allows you to travel to other countries
examples: She showed her passport at the border and the officer waved her through.
He lost his passport on holiday and had to contact the embassy.

answers.answer: She showed her passport at the border and the officer waved her through.
He cooked his passport in the oven for dinner on Sunday.
She wore her passport on her head to the beach.
They planted a passport in the garden near the gate.

sections.title: phone number
sections.question: phone number
sections.summary: a sequence of digits used to call someone on a telephone

senses.definition: a sequence of numbers that you dial to call someone on the telephone
examples: She wrote her phone number on the form so they could contact her.
Can I have your phone number in case I need to reach you?

answers.answer: She wrote her phone number on the form so they could contact her.
He ate his phone number for breakfast with a glass of juice.
She drove her phone number to the office every morning.
They planted a phone number in the garden and watered it daily.

sections.title: take a shower
sections.question: take a shower
sections.summary: to wash your body by standing under running water

partsOfSpeech.inflectionsLine: takes a shower, taking a shower, took a shower

senses.definition: to wash your whole body while standing under a shower
examples: She takes a shower every morning before going to work.
He took a shower after his run to cool down and clean up.

answers.answer: She takes a shower every morning before going to work.
He takes a shower at the supermarket to buy food.
She took a shower in the kitchen in order to cook dinner.
They take a shower at the library to borrow books.

sections.title: wake up
sections.question: wake up
sections.summary: to stop sleeping and become conscious

partsOfSpeech.inflectionsLine: wakes up, waking up, woke up

senses.definition: to stop sleeping; to become conscious after sleeping
examples: She wakes up early every morning and makes a cup of coffee.
He woke up at six o'clock and immediately got ready for work.

answers.answer: She wakes up early every morning and makes a cup of coffee.
He woke up his bicycle and rode it to school.
She wakes up dinner at seven o'clock every evening.
They wake up to the supermarket every Saturday morning.

senses.definition: a person's job or profession, especially as stated on an official form
examples: The form asked for her name, address, and occupation.
Under occupation, he wrote 'teacher' on the application form.

answers.answer: The form asked for her name, address, and occupation.
He cooked the occupation for dinner and served it with vegetables.
She drove her occupation to work and parked it outside.
They planted an occupation in the garden and watered it every day.
